title: Blitsen configuration
description: The "blitsen" key of package.json: the command Blitsen runs before ingest, and the directory of static web output it ingests.

build.description: Command run before ingest, from the directory holding this package.json. Blitsen runs it and consumes its output directory; it never inspects or configures the build tool.

output.description: Directory of static web output, relative to this package.json. It must contain index.html.

name.description: Application name. Sets the native window title and the default output file name.

addons.description: Native .node addons carried into the export, relative to this package.json. They live outside the output directory more often than not, so ingest cannot reach them and they have to be declared.
